quality.label: Photo quality checks
quality.help: Plain checks on each product photo: too small, blurry, too dark, wrong shape, cut off. Nothing is sent anywhere. Off until you turn it on.

video.label: Product video
video.help: A video on the product page: an uploaded clip or a YouTube, Vimeo or Facebook link. Shown as a clean picture with a play button; the player loads only when a customer taps. Off until you turn it on.

faq.label: Product FAQs
faq.help: Questions and answers on the product page: per product, per category (added to every product of it by itself) and shop-wide. Shown as a tidy list that opens on tap. Off until you turn it on.

erpSizeChart.label: ERP size chart
erpSizeChart.help: Use the size chart the ERP sends for a style when adding a product. Until the ERP ships it, a sample chart stands in (source Sample). The shop's own chart made from it is never overwritten by a later ERP change. Off until you turn it on.
